title: This week in 5 numbers: Employees struggle to find time for upskilling
summary: Here’s a roundup of numbers from the last week — including how many consecutive business days Bank of America employees are allowed to work remotely.

title: Feds propose ‘Trump Account’ regulations as older workers’ retirement hopes dwindle
summary: Trump Accounts will help eligible children “enjoy years of compound earnings for their future college, retirement and other needs,” an IRS leader said.

title: More than a third of workers say their retirement age has moved later
summary: Employees’ reasons for delaying retirement included the cost of living, not earning enough and a lack of savings.

title: Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds
summary: Poorly documented or misunderstood processes, fragmented data systems, and entrenched ways of working are impeding the transition, according to the report.

title: Gap between demand and hiring widens
summary: More candidates are applying for jobs in manufacturing especially, but companies aren’t successfully moving them into available roles, according to an ICIMS report.

title: Meta sued for allegedly firing manager who refused to sign an ‘inaccurate’ immigration letter
summary: The manager’s “refusal was based on his objectively reasonable and good-faith belief that he should not submit materially inaccurate statements to USCIS,” per a complaint.

title: Salesforce worker must arbitrate gender-based discrimination case
summary: Gender-based allegations that don't involve sexual harassment cannot invoke the Ending Forced Arbitration Act, a court determined.

title: Lowe’s lawsuit involving racist slurs to go to trial
summary: HR professionals take heed: Derogatory name-calling at work, even from customers, can embroil employers in lawsuits.

title: More than three-quarters of front-line managers say they lack necessary guidance
summary: A disconnect between company systems and operational needs has led to problems translating decisions into action, according to a report from Dayforce.

title: Only daily AI users feel positively about job security
summary: Unclear AI policies and a lack of training are compounding employee concerns about the technology, a SurveyMonkey and CNBC survey found.
